title: The page never scrolls sideways
note: Content wraps to the window instead of running past it; wide tables scroll inside their own box.
intent: A page that scrolls sideways has something wider than the window: a table, a long unbroken word, a fixed-width card, a negative margin. Find it and fix the cause, not the symptom (overflow-x: hidden on body hides content rather than fixing it). Give flex and grid children min-width: 0 so they can shrink, let long text wrap (overflow-wrap: anywhere), keep images and canvases at max-width: 100%, and put a wide table inside a wrapper with overflow-x: auto so only the table scrolls. Check the page at a narrow width (360 px) as well as a wide one. The page reports state().ui.overflowX; a positive number is how many pixels it runs past the window.

check.note: The document is not wider than the window: state().ui.overflowX is 0.

port: The owner of styles.css sets box-sizing, min-width: 0 on flex and grid children and a max-width on media once; facets keep their own blocks inside that.
